title: Derive exact audited membership for prose-scoped finding-registry rows
description:
Split out of eshyra-o9bd.19.1.6 (PR #476) on 2026-07-26 after the churn stop rule triggered on two consecutive fresh full reviews.

ROOT REASON FOR THE SPLIT: the finding registry contains two different kinds of row and only one of them belongs to registry construction.
  * QUERY-SCOPED rows: membership is derivable by executing a predicate against the committed pack. These were derived correctly in eshyra-o9bd.19.1.6 — rule corpus 335, spells 319, engine-pending clauses 794, half-damage 93.
  * PROSE-SCOPED rows: membership must be reconciled against the prose of the four 2026-07-24 audit reviews before any predicate can be written. Two attempts filled these with a single exemplar plus a boilerplate justification sentence, which is a schema-conformant facade and cannot prove non-recurrence.

This bead owns the second kind. It is corpus analysis, not registry construction.

SCOPE: for every row that eshyra-o9bd.19.1.6 marks membershipStatus='underived', reconcile the finding's true population against /mnt/d/eshyra-2026-07-24-audit-repair-bead-plan.md and the committed pack, then replace the placeholder with an executable query plus a reproducible baseline snapshot of identities, and flip the row to membershipStatus='derived'.

KNOWN EXAMPLES (not the full set — the full set is whatever the registry marks underived):
  indep:008  '23 incomplete locators'                    currently n=1
  sol:CAP-003 spell mechanics shallower than source      currently n=1
  indep:006  creature trigger/branch/timing/lifecycle    currently n=1
  sol:CAP-004 creature/stat-block mechanics incomplete   currently n=1
  fable:F3   creature rider/ongoing damage untyped       currently n=1
  opus:F-15  spellcasting granularity                    currently n=1
  fable:F8   rule keying/duplication hygiene             currently n=1

LIKELY BLOCKED ON: eshyra-o9bd.19.1.1 (clause IR) for any row whose target is clause-level rather than record-level, because the pack cannot express clause identity until that lands.

GATE: while any row remains underived, the finding registry's closure predicate returns false and eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4 cannot certify zero-repeat closure. That is deliberate — an underived row must block closure rather than pass as an exemplar.

COUNT HYGIENE: a generated, regenerable snapshot of member identities is required and is NOT a hand-copied count. Transcribing a total (23, 79, 391) into an assertion remains forbidden.
